format: Six-frame 640×360 horizontal WebP sprite atlases; CSS discrete frame animation

prompts.training: Create a production animation SPRITE SHEET for a beautiful browser Dragon Ball RPG. Six equally sized rectangular frames arranged EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows, edge-to-edge, NO gutters, borders, text, labels or interface. Whole canvas aspect 8:3, every individual frame aspect 16:9. Each cell shows the SAME locked camera, background and character positions, differing ONLY in animation poses, so the six images play as one seamless running loop in reading order. Authentic ORIGINAL early Dragon Ball, charming detailed 16-bit / Nintendo DS anime pixel game art with crisp outlines, warm sunshine and readable small faces. Scene: young Goku with black spiky hair and young bald Krillin with six forehead dots wearing their classic orange Kame training gis, blue belts and big green weighted turtle shells, running on a sandy coastal trail delivering wooden milk crates. Full bodies and feet visible in every cell. Goku on left, Krillin on right, both facing right in three-quarter side view, same center positions throughout as if running on treadmill. Master Roshi in pink shirt, sunglasses and white beard watches near distant pink Kame House, blue ocean and palms. Their legs cycle through 6 anatomically correct running poses, arms hold milk crates consistently, turtle shells bounce slightly, dust puffs change. Frames 1-6: left contact, left down, flight, right contact, right down, flight. Left and right knees bend forward correctly, two arms and two legs each, NO backwards feet. Keep Roshi/background perfectly identical in every cell. No later Dragon Ball Z forms, no transformed hair, no collage perspectives. Carefully make all six frames visually match and stay inside each cell with generous 8% safe margins.
prompts.rest: Create a production animation SPRITE SHEET for a beautiful browser Dragon Ball RPG. Six equally sized rectangular frames arranged EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows, edge-to-edge, NO gutters, borders, text, labels or interface. Whole canvas aspect 8:3, every individual frame aspect 16:9. Each cell shows the SAME locked camera, background and character positions, differing ONLY in tiny animation movement, so the six images play as one seamless relaxed bathing loop in reading order. Authentic ORIGINAL early Dragon Ball, charming detailed 16-bit / Nintendo DS anime pixel game art, crisp outlines, cozy golden light. Scene: a big classic ROUND wooden Japanese bathtub with brass faucet and opaque warm turquoise water in Kame House's cozy tiled bathroom, tropical palm tree and sea visible through round window. Young Goku identifiable by spiky black hair sits on left, bald young Krillin identifiable by six forehead dots sits in center, adult Yamcha with shaggy long black hair and cheek scar on right, all happily relaxing. Blue Puar sits on a folded towel beside the tub. Only heads, shoulders and arms visible ABOVE thick foam and opaque water and HIGH wooden tub rim; everything below shoulders is fully concealed. Wholesome comedic cartoon bath, no nudity, no suggestive details. Their hands rest naturally on tub rim, all contained comfortably in frame. Gentle loop animation: water ripples expand around them across six frames, steam rises slowly, tiny shoulder bob and eyelid blink at frame 3, relaxed smiles. Frame 6 returns smoothly to frame1. Same room, tub, window, faces, clothes-free exposed shoulders ONLY and character scale/coordinates in ALL cells. All characters clearly legible even at small display size. No extra limbs, no changing faces, no late-era transformations. Full tub bottom and bathroom floor visible in every frame; generous safe margins.
